Author: egorxe
Content:
@Tim 'mithro' Ansell  @Andrew Wingate 
Zedulo ordered CoBs for both of our Run2 chips (Naxos and Cabrera). But it would be very beneficial if you could ship some Cabrera dies (about 50-100 out of the total 1000) as bare dies. Apart from the MCU compatible with the CoB, Cabrera contains some flash cell test structures derived from the UMich ones designed during old Google-funded runs. To test these structures, we'll need custom packaging or probing, so we're asking to ship some dies unpackaged. Is it possible?

Author: anfroholic
Content: You will be receiving some unpackaged die that is still in the tape.

Author: anfroholic
Content: Keep in mind we only got 6 wafers so we will be doing the larger sort in a couple months or less. There will be many more coming as well.

Author: egorxe
Content: Perfect! So there will be some bare dies in both batches?

Author: mithro_
Content: Can't promise anything. But I'm hoping to get most people back a number of bare die.
